table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname= item.name,
			department = dbo.department.name, 
			salesman = dbo.users.username, 
			issuereqinvcode = dbo.issuereqheader.issuereqinvcode, 
			smanname=salesman.name,
         date = dbo.issuereqheader.date,   
         dbo.issuereqheader.deptcode,
 			dbo.issuereqheader.remarks,	
        	looseqty = issuereqdetail.qty,
		itempacking=(select itempacking.name from itempacking where itempacking.packcode=item.packcode),
			Id       = dbo.issuereqdetail.IDENTITYCOL ,
			section=(select section.name from section where section.sectcode=issuereqdetail.sectcode)

    FROM issuereqheader, 
			issuereqdetail, 
			users, 
			item ,
		   department ,
			salesman
 
   WHERE ( dbo.issuereqheader.issuereqinvcode = :ar_issuereqinvcode ) AND
			( dbo.issuereqheader.issuereqinvcode = dbo.issuereqdetail.issuereqinvcode) AND
			( dbo.issuereqheader.deptcode = dbo.department.deptcode ) AND 
			( dbo.issuereqheader.Smancode = dbo.SalesMan.Salesmancode ) AND 
			( dbo.issuereqheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND 
			( dbo.issuereqdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)
			
ORDER BY dbo.issuereqdetail.IDENTITYCOL
